items.lede: The modern Atari VCS is being officially retired with the firm’s decision to shut down the Linux-based AMD APU-powered machine's software store early next year.
items.title: Retro Atari VCS platform will end with the closure of its software store in February 2027

items.lede: Following a decade long saga of delays, name changes, and Atari having to assure backers of a crowdfunding campaign that its retro console wasn't doomed, the Atari VCS platform is being retired early next year. On February 1st, 2027, the Atari VCS software store is shutting down, according to an announcement posted to the Atari […]
items.title: The Atari VCS saga will come to an end next year when its software store closes
